subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

An old head on young shoulders

options.text: A young person who acts or speaks like an older person
A young person who is lazy.
A person who is slow at understanding things.
A young person who looks old.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"An old head on young shoulders"** means a young person who acts or speaks with the wisdom or maturity of an older person. (एक युवा व्यक्ति जो वृद्ध व्यक्ति की तरह व्यवहार करता है या बोलता है)

 
 
• **Example:** Despite being only 16, John often provides advice with the wisdom of **an old head on young shoulders.**
 
 
 
• **Explanation:** The idiom signifies a young individual who displays maturity and understanding beyond their years. (यह मुहावरा एक युवा व्यक्ति को दर्शाता है जो अपनी उम्र से अधिक परिपक्वता और समझ दिखाता है)
 
 
• **Example:** Sarah's insightful comments during the meeting showed she had **an old head on young shoulders.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** A young person who is lazy. (एक युवा व्यक्ति जो आलसी है)

 
 
• **Example:** Tom is a young person who is lazy and prefers playing video games all day.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** A person who is slow at understanding things. (एक व्यक्ति जो चीजों को समझने में धीमा है)
 
 
• **Example:** Mary is often slow at understanding things, so she needs extra time to complete her tasks.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** A young person who looks old. (एक युवा व्यक्ति जो बूढ़ा दिखता है)
 
 
• **Example:** Due to his health condition, Jake is a young person who looks old.
 
 

45:Tb73,

The correct answer is: **Option 2.**
